verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents the money-movement pieces: amount splits configured on payins, merchant deposits with configurable frequency, per-merchant billing profiles, and an embeddable reporting component. Nothing in the evidence shows how legible that money is. The pack never documents per-seller or platform fee-account balances, a traceable chain from charge to split to payout, or penny-level reconciliation. missing for 10: per-seller and platform fee-account balance views, documented charge-to-split-to-payout traceability, reconciliation reports or exports tied to deposits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform's money is legible — balances by seller and by my own fee accounts, every movement traceable from charge through split to payout, reconcilable to the penny
